fields.name: Pettenderly
fields.tagline: Turn pet photos into portraits worth keeping.
fields.short: Pettenderly turns photos of your cat or dog into downloadable AI pet portraits in watercolor, royal, studio and window-seat styles.
fields.description: Pettenderly turns cat and dog photos into downloadable AI pet portraits. Upload one to five photos of the same pet and choose watercolor, royal, studio or sunny window-seat styles. Paid credits start at $4.99 for 12, with subscriptions from $9.90 per month. There is no free generation plan. Failed generations do not use credits. Digital images only; no physical printing or shipping.
features: Upload 1–5 photos of the same cat or dog
Choose from watercolor, royal, studio and window-seat styles
Failed generations do not use credits

checkpoint: Pettenderly is in the review queue, Standard Free; same-email sign-in can track status.
